TITLE: Tech View – Row Text 13 px and Progress Percentage 11 px at Every Density
FILED: SV-11420 https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-11420 · Story Defect · parent SV-10049 (Ready for QA, read live) · Medium · label board-tech-view · relates to SV-10049 · 16 Oct 2026

h2. Description

*Tech View's row text should be 14 px at every density, and the progress percentage should be 12 px.* On staging the row text is 13 px and the percentage 11 px, at Compact, Regular and Comfortable alike.

For example,

* the work order number, customer, unit, VIN, advisor, lead and price in a Tech View row are 13 px
* the "0%" beside the progress bar is 11 px
* Board View's card text, by contrast, is 14 px

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin and check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, type a customer in *Search* (for example {{ZZAUTOTEST F1 Compact Text}}) and click *Tech View*.
# Click the density button and choose *Regular*, then *Compact*, then *Comfortable*, and each time check the size of the text in a row (for example with the browser's inspector, Computed > font-size).
#* Row text: 13 px at every density.
#* The percentage beside the progress bar: 11 px at every density.

*Actual Result:*

* Row text 13 px and percentage 11 px at every density.

*Expected Result:*

* Row text 14 px at every density; the percentage 12 px at every density.
